de.my_domain.abalone.gui

Class BallPanel

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.Component
      • java.awt.Container
        • javax.swing.JComponent
          • javax.swing.JPanel
            • de.my_domain.abalone.gui.GridPanel
              • de.my_domain.abalone.gui.BallPanel
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable, javax.accessibility.Accessible

    public class BallPanel
extends GridPanel
    The BallPanel Class. The BallPanel class extends GridPanel and is used to represent an slot on the BoardPanel. It saves row and diag coordinates of the corresponding slot as well as the color in which the slot is displayed. To represent a edge panel of the game the color must simply be set to null. A BallPanel can have distinct states which determine the look of the BallPanel. It can be normal, selected or highlighted. The class provides methods to change the color and the state of each BallPanel so that the BallPanel is mutable and that it can be reused.

      • setColor

        void setColor(Color color)
        The setColor method is a setter method of the Color attribute in which the Ball is painted. The Ball will not be painted if color == null. If and only if the color is changed by the method, the ball will be repainted. This avoids unneeded repaints of the BallPanels.
        Parameters:
        color - The new color that is assigned to the BallPanel.

      • setState

        void setState(int state)
        The setState method is a setter method of the state attribute which decides if the ball is highlighted or selected. The Ball will not be selected or highlighted if state == NORMAL_STATE. If and only if the status is changed by the method, the ball will be repainted. This avoids unneeded repaints of the BallPanels.
        Parameters:
        state - The new state that is assigned to the BallPanel.

      • paintComponent

        public void paintComponent(java.awt.Graphics g)
        The paintComponent method overrides the paintComponent method of GridPanel. It calls the paintComponent method of the GridPanel first to draw the horizontal line, then two diagonal lines and the ball as a circle are drawn. Finally, it is evaluated if the ball needs to be marked as selected or highlighted. The colors for the operations are set in DesignUtil.
        Overrides:
        paintComponent in class GridPanel
        Parameters:
        g - Is a Graphics object received from the caller of the method.

      • drawBall

        private void drawBall(java.awt.Graphics2D g2d,
                      int diameter)
        The drawBall method evaluates if the color of the ball is not null. If this is the case then it draws a circle in the this color and the given diameter. The circle is drawn centered and perfectly symmetrical.
        Parameters:
        g2d - Is a Graphics2D object.
        diameter - Is the diameter of the drawn Ball as an integer.

      • drawStates

        private void drawStates(java.awt.Graphics2D g2d,
                        int diameter)
        The drawStates method evaluates which state the circle is in. If the circle is selected or highlighted a smaller circle is drawn in the center of the JPanel. The circle is drawn centered and perfectly symmetrical. The colors of the circles are specified in DesignUtil.
        Parameters:
        g2d - Is a Graphics2D object.
        diameter - Is the diameter of the drawn Ball as an integer.
